Usage:
  agentsview stats [flags]

Flags:
      --agent string                  Filter by agent (claude, codex, cursor, ... or 'all') (default "all")
      --exclude-project stringArray   Exclude these projects (repeatable)
      --format human|json             Output format: human or json (default human)
  -h, --help                          help for stats
      --include-automated             Include automated sessions (excluded by default)
      --include-git-outcomes          Include git-derived outcome stats (commits, LOC, files)
      --include-github-outcomes       Include GitHub PR outcome stats via gh (implies --include-git-outcomes)
      --include-one-shot              Include one-shot sessions (excluded by default)
      --include-project stringArray   Restrict to these projects (repeatable)
      --json                          Emit JSON output (alias for --format json)
      --since string                  Start of window (duration like 28d, or YYYY-MM-DD) (default "28d")
      --timezone string               Timezone for temporal (default: local system timezone)
      --until string                  End of window (YYYY-MM-DD; default: now)
